en.html:
本家〝You will settle this.〟
本家〝With your own hands, cut the bond between this incompetent—Akitaka—and House Minato.〟
Chief〝...Forgive me, Kageaki.〟

en.html:
本家〝Leave, Akitaka. Never again call yourself Minato. Never appear before me again.〟
Chief〝...Kageaki...〟
Chief〝House Minato... Hikaru... I leave them in your care.〟
